name: grow-and-learn
description: Modern daycare and preschool website for young children

scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'script.js'].forEach(file => fs.copyFileSync(path.join('src', file), path.join('dist', file))); console.log('Build completed: files copied to dist/');"
